title: Flankers-NEAR
description: This dataset contains EEG recordings from a flanker word/pseudoword lexical decision task collected at the NeuroCognition Laboratory in San Diego. Participants viewed four-letter real words and pseudowords flanked by identical, different, or no flanking words, while EEG was recorded to examine neural responses associated with lexical processing under flanker conditions. The dataset was collected under San Diego State University's IRB oversight.
methods_description: Participants sat in a darkened, sound-attenuated room and viewed stimuli on a 24in LCD monitor at 60in viewing distance. They were presented with 90 four-letter real words and 90 pseudowords under three flanker conditions (no flanker, identical flankers, different flankers), totaling 270 trials. Each trial began with a purple fixation cross (1000ms), followed by a white fixation cross (500ms), then the stimulus (150ms), followed by a blank screen until participant response via a game controller.
